summary: #netnarr has the great @cogdog building the syndication feed for their planet. #clmooc got stuck with me. I just made an RSS feed in @inoreader and then embedded an iframe. Let me worry about accessibility and functionality first. Will get to pretty next.

body_html: #netnarr has the great @cogdog building the syndication feed for their planet. #clmooc got stuck with me. I just made an RSS feed in @inoreader and then embedded an iframe. Let me worry about accessibility and functionality first. Will get to pretty next.
